proposal_rationale: Read context/baseline.json, context/protocol.json, and both complete captured immutable evaluation artifacts, including the latest artifact-c18f5abf70154cf9bd7920877036d6b9 at commit 278ab8eb0906e1ab3d1dbf15f3330a05835c475f and its full history. The baseline (40, 0.55, 0, 0) remains the only rank-eligible result, with cell area 161954 um2, score 1.0, and zero electrical violations. Candidate 1 (40, 0.55, 1, 0) had cell area 157315 um2 but failed with 12 max_slew and 5 max_cap violations. Candidate 2 (40, 0.55, 1, 10) had cell area 157230 um2, setup/hold slack 0.556154/0.0603264 ns, and only 2 max_slew violations, with zero max_cap and max_fanout violations; it still failed electrical qualification. Both candidates have empty energy maps and are rank-ineligible, so neither establishes energy or score improvement. Choose the previously untried (40, 0.55, 1, 20) for the third and final new physical candidate. Increasing only repair_margin to the remaining allowed value directly follows the observed reduction in electrical violations while retaining the settings that yielded lower cell area. Counts without violation severity cannot establish that margin 20 will close the remaining slew violations, and repair overhead, timing, and energy remain uncertain. The objective is normalized cell area times the geometric mean of workload energy ratios, not die area. Physical and measurement qualification and any score improvement require independent evaluation. RTL, period 10526 ps, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen; no EDA, screening search, model, or additional agent was used. Local exact-key schema, frozen-domain membership, uniqueness against both captured histories, and final-slot checks passed. The required python3 tools/run_ppa.py validate command exited 1 with ModuleNotFoundError for run_ppa_workflow_study; the official validation gate remains unverified.
